newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -STRUGGLING T-BONDS TO SLIP TOWARDS 110-23.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -STRUGGLING T-BONDS TO SLIP TOWARDS 110-23.

text.p: September T-bond futures will slide lower on Monday following sharp declines on Friday, technical analysts said.
"T-bonds are struggling to hold above 112-17," said Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge.
"On the downside, there is a lot of support from 112-00 down to 110-23. In due course, I suspect 110-23 will be hit during the week. It is not a pretty picture."
At 0959 GMT, September T-bond futures were at 112-31 in automated trade, up 9/32 from Friday's Chicago pit settlement.
Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London, also saw declines for T-bonds, down to support at 111-22.
"There is some support from the previous low at 112-07 and then strong support at 111-22, 50 percent of the 106-12 to 116-31 rally," he said.
To the upside, Cheng noted resistance at 112-30, the 24 percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from 115-06 down to 112-07.
Above there, further resistance was offered at 113-11, the 38 percent retracement of the same rally, he said.
Gifford noted resistance at 113-17. That level was the low on July 9.
There was also a temporary level at 113-05, which was likely to be the upside limit for this session, she said.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were at 93.995, up 0.010 in automated trade.
